title: Figure 11: Superluminal nonlocal communication system spanning a spacelike interval
description: Color optical schematic of the slit-imaging system with an Argon Ion Laser, BBO crystal and polarizing splitter, where both photon arms run through "1 km" fiber-optic segments (shown as curved breaks) to image slits S2 with a switch/detectors and to object slits S1 and a "Camera" with "0"/"1" pattern plots. The caption reads "Figure 11. A Superluminal Nonlocal Communication System in Which the Communication Spans a Spacelike Interval." Below begins Section XI, "Example: Real-Time Earth Control of Mars Rover."
